$comment: Shared test vectors for @konstant-studio/auth v2 (Node and Python consume this same file). Every value here is fake. `world` is what the platform would hold; `cases` are what the library must answer. `reason` is the PLATFORM's answer (parity-tested against /v1/authorize on a scratch copy of the C0b branch); `offline_reason` is set only where an offline decision cannot tell reasons apart and uses a coarser (still denying) one.

contract.note: Pinned at the accepted C0b2 with its fixes (guard first, mandatory expect_service, uniform key_not_found, audit bounds).
contract.resources_note: The `resources` field of the snapshot (and the lookups / tenantOf cases that need it) is C0f, which is not yet in a committed platform build: the e2e parity runners skip every case marked requires_platform=C0f until the pin moves to a commit that has it.

lookups.$comment: tenantFor(kind, local_id) / resourcesFor(tenant, kind) from the cached snapshot (platform C0f resources). `snapshot`: fresh (default) | stale (platform down, cache older than its TTL, inside the stale-read window) | beyond-stale | cold-down | no-resources-field (a platform without C0f). Raw/odd arguments are given as-is (JSON null, number, object).
